items.title: Belo Horizonte (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 4 #94181
items.en_title: Belo Horizonte (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 4 #94181
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Belo Horizonte (MG) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 2,632,913.61; proposals close Dec 4 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
